sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Plowmania nyctaginoides is a Mesoamerican shrub of wet montane habitats. The available botanical accounts emphasize its distinctive flowers; reliable measurements for the plant as a whole were not found.

sections.title: Flowers
sections.text: Its showy corolla can reach about 5 cm long, with an orange tube, vermilion to scarlet lobes and a golden-yellow throat. These characters match the plate. Fruit color is not described here because the sources consulted did not verify it.
